package.name: motoman_gp400_support

description.p: ROS-Industrial support for the Motoman GP400.
This package contains configuration data, 3D models and launch files for Motoman GP400 series of manipulators.

Joint limits and maximum joint velocities are based on the information found in MOTOMAN-GP400,GP600 INSTRUCTIONS (HW2481718) version 201433-1CD, rev 0 and in MOTOMAN-MH400 II INSTRUCTIONS (HW1482181) version 171833-1CD, rev 3
Before using any of the configuration files and / or meshes included in this package, be sure to check they are correct for the particular robot model and configuration you intend to use them with.
Note that there are possible interferences between the axes L(2) and U(3) that are not checked by this urdf model. The motion planner will have to account for those.
